identification: Continental (probably Middle Eastern or Turkish/Cypriot style) silver fruit bowl, heavily repousse with roses and scrollwork, scalloped rim, three small ball feet, plain scalloped well, about 19 cm across. Marked 900 only (tiny punch in the well, photo 4), so 90% silver. No maker, no country mark, no tughra readable. 20th century.
